verdict.rationale: Notte's docs describe a credential vault where secrets are injected into the browser session but never exposed to the LLM, plus persistent cookies/login state and 'verified identities' (emails/phones) for sign-up and 2FA flows, directly matching the core of the story. However, there's no explicit walkthrough of a TOTP code being generated/entered by the agent, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that 2FA login flows work end-to-end in practice. Missing for 10: concrete TOTP-specific workflow documentation, independent verification of vault+2FA login success.
